# AMD Machines

> AMD Machines (Advanced Manufacturing Development LLC) designs and builds custom automation and robotic systems — 30+ years in business, 2,500+ machines delivered across North America. Core expertise: automated assembly systems. Sales and service from Chicago, IL; manufacturing in Querétaro, MX. Known for short lead times: simple custom machines in as little as 6 weeks; complex systems in 24–26 weeks vs. 40–42 weeks typical for overseas builders. Integrates FANUC, ABB, Yaskawa robots with Cognex vision, Atlas Copco fastening, and Rockwell controls.

## Solutions

- [Automated Assembly Machines & Systems](https://amdmachines.com/solutions/assembly/): custom assembly automation, AMD's core expertise
- [Custom Automation](https://amdmachines.com/solutions/custom-automation/): custom automation solutions and special purpose machines
- [Robotic Cells](https://amdmachines.com/solutions/robotic-cells/): custom robotic cells for welding, assembly, tending, and finishing
- [Welding Automation](https://amdmachines.com/solutions/welding/): robotic MIG, TIG, and spot welding systems
- [Test Systems](https://amdmachines.com/solutions/test-systems/): leak testing, end-of-line and functional test systems
- [Machine Tending](https://amdmachines.com/solutions/machine-tending/): robotic CNC and press tending
- [Machine Vision](https://amdmachines.com/solutions/machine-vision/): automated inspection and vision-guided robotics
- [Material Handling](https://amdmachines.com/solutions/material-handling/): automated material handling systems
- [All solutions](https://amdmachines.com/solutions/)
